method: Separately approved human administrator CLI imports and immediate reviewed stack-policy installation/readback, private complete plan/template/event/drift exports, independent local security reviews, read-only AWS MCP configuration/ownership checks and public HEAD/dig comparisons. No resource recreation or serving-configuration modernization was part of adoption.

authority_boundary.all_aws_mutations_performed_by: Human administrator CLI after separate preparation, protection, exact-ARN execution/policy and drift-scheduling approval gates.

resources.DirectComparison: MATCH; original target/dates preserved, unsupported native drift.

verified_protections_and_templates.policy_timing_limit: Human execution approvals acknowledged the short post-import policy attachment gap and the chained immediate-policy sequence. Installed content is verified; local receipt mtimes do not independently prove exact API installation times or uninterrupted policy coverage.
verified_protections_and_templates.protection_limit: Retain is not a backup or replacement prevention. Termination protection blocks stack deletion, not ordinary updates. Stack policy prevents replacement/removal during covered updates, not every possible in-place configuration change.

native_drift_and_direct_coverage.limitation: Native drift checks supported explicit properties only. It does not adopt external records, prove complete equivalence, cover every default/computed property or establish runtime/signing health. Unsupported policies/alias targets, legacy bucket ACLs, records, certificate associations and public DNS/HTTP were checked directly. No automatic remediation was performed.

final_live_verification.full_service_configuration: MATCH: both buckets' websites/ACLs/encryption/public-access/ownership/optional absences and policies, expected web system/business tags, complete CloudFront config/tags, original OAI, external ACM metadata/validation, all records and KMS policy/alias configuration.
final_live_verification.expected_metadata: Only previously recorded web import ownership metadata changed: exact CloudFormation system tags on two buckets and CloudFront ETag/LastModified metadata. Serving config/business tags/CallerReferences/IDs stayed unchanged. Key and hosted-zone tags remain empty; skipped tag updates did not replace resources.
final_live_verification.scope_limit: The full service audit was not repeated during final ownership/signing reads. Installed policy/template evidence remains the verified batch exports, not fresh final policy/template API calls.

final_public_health.limitation: No regression observed in point-in-time checks. This is not a continuous availability or unconditional zero-disruption guarantee.

external_and_untouched_scope: All eleven DNS record sets, including NS/SOA, web routing, mail and both ACM validation CNAMEs; hosted-zone import does not adopt records.
Existing ACM certificate, domain registration/registrar administration, public delegation and parent DS administration.
Shared IAM/S3Access publishing role, GitHub OIDC, account audit and unrelated mail resources.
Disabled legacy distribution and legacy bucket, bucket objects/backups, KMS grants and signing/private material.

private_evidence_handling.private_export_directories_and_files: 0700 directories and 0600 files, Git-ignored; review/redact configuration/events/identity before publication.

operational_handoff.next_step: Human review of final evidence. Any explicit freeze release, later ordinary update/publication plan or removal of only added read-supplement statements requires its own decision; preserve unrelated permissions.
operational_handoff.publication_warning: Every push to main, including infrastructure-only changes, triggers the existing S3 website publication workflow. No automatic infrastructure deployment workflow was added. Do not push, merge or publish while the existing freeze remains in place.
